inputs.doc: Fixed inputs, written once on the first step and unchanged after: sample_id / fq1 / fq2 / organism / genome_index

current_stage.doc: qc | trim | align | sort | dedup | quant | diff | enrich | done

completed_steps.doc: Names of completed stages (the model rewrites the full list each step)

open_issues.doc: Open issues (e.g. low mapping rate, high duplicate rate)
